title: PerezBlanco2026: Wrist-motion (4-direction pointing) motor-execution dataset
description: A multimodal dataset of simultaneous EEG, EMG and kinematics recorded from 45 healthy adults performing a four-direction wrist-pointing task with a 3-DoF wrist exoskeleton (Biomech Wrist). Participants performed flexion, extension, radial deviation and ulnar deviation movements (motor execution) to control a cursor with continuous visual feedback. The dataset is intended for biomarker research, motor control and neurorehabilitation applications, and is distributed in BIDS format.
methods_description: Eight EEG channels over sensorimotor areas (C3, C1, Cz, C2, C4, CP3, CPz, CP4) and eight EMG channels were recorded at 512 Hz with a g.tec g.USBamp, referenced to the right ear with AFz as ground. The paradigm is overt motor execution (not motor imagery). Participants completed at least 8 runs of 40 cue-based trials each (10 per movement direction) using the Biomech Wrist exoskeleton. Flexion-extension controlled horizontal cursor motion and radial-ulnar deviation controlled vertical motion. Data were recorded with BCI2000 and converted to EDF/BIDS.
